svg.text: MARTIN
QA-701 · Inspection plan
Do not ship a part that fails its class
Rev F.2 · inches · kernel 6.2.0
PARAMETRIC — do not scale. Datum: sill top / latch face x=0
QC-01 [VERIFIED/TBM] Confirm overall opening 143.000″ ± 0.25″ on site tol T1
QC-02 [VERIFIED] Run sits on driveway slab; pack only if outriggers leave slab (drop_off default 0) tol T1
QC-03 [T0] Stock moisture — PT for kick + planters dry before prime; SPF acclimate tol —
QC-04 [T2] Four posts finished length 67.000" within ±1/32" tol ±0.031
QC-05 [T2] K-001 + R-001 + R-002 identical nuki_len; cassettes = bay_clear tol ±0.031
QC-06 [T2] Through-nuki only K-001/R-001/R-002; Q cassettes in grooves; Q-001 0.75″ dog gauge, others 1.15″ max aperture tol binary
QC-07 [T2] Foot tenon 2.500×4.500×3.500 enters F-003; lifts out for winter tol +0.03/−0
QC-08 [T1] Dry-assemble: plumb / no racking; Tree of Life + nested-rect cassettes seat; 0.75″ gauge must not pass Q-001; 1.15″ must not pass Q-002/Q-003 tol plumb 1/8″ in 65″
QC-09 [T2] Gate against house; oak pivots lift-off; latch into P0; no planter at P0 tol —
QC-10 [T0] No glue on kusabi or nuki locking faces tol binary
QC-11 [T0] Paint: ease arrises, end-grain sealer, PT dry then prime, 2 finish coats; mask joinery tol —
QC-12 [T0] Winter knock-down rehearsal before first storm season tol —
QC-13 [T1] Ladder sills sit on driveway; two planters garden-side of privacy bays only tol ±0.125
QC-14 [T2] Gate vs cap clearance ≥ 0.50″; gate bottom ≤ 0.375″ (dog) tol min 0.38 cap / max 0.50 bottom
QC-15 [T1] Planters planted + optional in-box stone; air gap from posts; drainage slots tol —
QC-16 [T0] No concrete, no post holes, no gravel/stone PAD; stone only inside planters tol binary
QC-17 [T1] Cap soffit light dado + IP67 24V tape (8836N52); driver 8836N24 in P3 planter, not at house wall tol —
GEOMETRY GATE (kernel)
OK gate/cap clearance — 0.5" ≥ 0.50" spec
OK nuki cheek — 2.0" each side of 1.50″ rail in 5.50″ post
OK foot tenon shoulders — 0.5" × 0.5"
OK elevation stack — 63.5" slats + 1.5" cap = 65.0"
OK Prairie cassette ratio ≈ φ — 1.618 (L2/L1 lights; belts stay 2×4 ribbons)
OK unique PART_IDs — 41
OK planter ballast vs wind (planning) — 1521.7 lb / 1311.1 lb ratio 1.16
